llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The Prometheus Go implementation already uses a compiled regex cache in the Matcher struct, but its Matches method needs to be updated to return an error to surface regex compilation issues. The Grafana Alerting TypeScript implementation, however, re-compiles the regex on every match call and silently swallows errors, requiring both caching and error surfacing changes.

FILES:
- prometheus/model/labels/matcher.go — Already has compiled regex cache but needs method signature changed to return error
- prometheus/model/labels/regexp.go — Contains FastRegexMatcher implementation used for caching
- prometheus/model/labels/matcher_test.go — Tests that will need updating for new Matches signature
- grafana/packages/grafana-alerting/src/grafana/matchers/utils.ts — Re-compiles regex on every call and needs caching and error surfacing
- grafana/packages/grafana-alerting/src/grafana/matchers/types.ts — Type definitions for LabelMatcher used in the matcher implementation
